questions.q: What did David know for sure when Hiram, king of Tyre, sent messengers, cedar trees, carpenters, and masons to build a house for him?
questions.a: David knew for sure that Yahweh had established him as king over Israel.

questions.q: What was the result when David took more wives in Jerusalem?
questions.a: David became the father of more sons and daughters.

questions.q: What were the names of the sons born to David in Jerusalem?
questions.a: The sons born to David in Jerusalem were Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

questions.q: What did David do when he heard that the Philistines were out looking for him?
questions.a: David went out to fight against the Philistines.

questions.q: Where did the Philistines set up their battle lines?
questions.a: The Philistines set up their battle lines in the Valley of the Rephaim.

questions.q: What did Yahweh answer David when David asked if he should attack the Philistines?
questions.a: Yahweh told David to attack them, because Yahweh would certainly give them into David’s hand.

questions.q: What did David name the place where he defeated the Philistines?
questions.a: David named it Baal Perazim, because God had broken through his enemies there like a flood of water breaking through a dam.

questions.q: What did David order his soldiers to do to the gods that the Philistines had abandoned?
questions.a: David ordered his soldiers to burn the gods that the Philistines had abandoned.

questions.q: Where did God tell David to attack the Philistines when they raided the valley again?
questions.a: God told David to circle around behind them and attack through the balsam trees.

questions.q: What was David to hear before he attacked the Philistines?
questions.a: David was to hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees.

questions.q: What did David do after God gave him these instructions?
questions.a: David obeyed God and defeated the Philistines, chasing them from Gibeon to Gezer.

questions.q: What did Yahweh cause all the nations to do when David’s fame went out to all the lands?
questions.a: Yahweh caused all the nations to fear David.

commentary.text: —In this chapter we have an account of, 1. David's kingdom established. 2. His family built up. 3. His enemies defeated. This is repeated from 2Sa 5. Let the fame of David be looked upon as a type and figure of the exalted honour of the Son of David.
